name: Calendar
description: Month view with your own events — click a day, type a line
author: Lattice

config.label: Week starts on
config.help: Which day sits in the first column. Monday for most of the world, Sunday for the US.

sections.title: Adding an event
items: Click a day, then type in the box at the bottom and press Enter. The day you clicked is the day it lands on.
Start the line with a time and it is kept: `9:30 Standup` is stored as 09:30 plus the title `Standup`. Without a time it is an all-day entry and sorts above the timed ones.
Click the ✕ on a row to delete it. There is no undo — but deleting is one click, and typing it again is one line.

sections.title: Reading the month
items: A dot under a number means that day has something on it. The month always shows six weeks, so the grid does not jump in height as you page through.
Days from the neighbouring months are shown greyed — clicking one jumps to that month rather than making it look like the entry landed in the wrong place.
The ‹ and › buttons move one month. The title is clickable and takes you back to today.

sections.title: What it stores
items: Only what you typed, per widget — the events are kept in this widget's own storage, so two calendars do not share a list.
Nothing is uploaded anywhere. There is no account, no sync, and no network permission in this version.
The selected day is remembered too, so reopening the card lands where you left off.

changes: First release: month view, click a day, type a line to add an event.
A leading time (`9:30 …`) is parsed and kept; the rest is the title.
Six-week grid so the card does not change height between months.
